name: Novation Launchkey Mini MK3

sources.title: Launchkey Mini [MK3] User Guide 1.1 (Novation)
sources.note: pitch and modulation touch strips; 8 knobs; 16 pads with Session / Drum / Custom pad modes (hold Shift, press a top-row pad: Session, Drum, Custom left; Device, Volume, Pan, Sends, Custom pot modes right); custom modes send notes (pads) and CCs (knobs), edited in Novation Components; Shift + Transpose picks the keyboard MIDI channel; ports "Launchkey Mini MK3 (DAW Port)" on Mac, "MIDI IN2" on Windows for the DAW. No note or CC numbers are printed.

sources.title: Launchkey [MK3] Programmer's Reference Guide v1 (Novation; the full-size MK3 family)
sources.note: the family powers into Standalone mode; keys, pitch/mod wheels, sustain and the Drum layout of the pads stay on the MIDI port, the rest of the surface talks only to a DAW on the DAW port; note-off = note-on velocity 0; mentions script compatibility with the Launchkey Mini [MK3]

sources.title: Ableton Live 12 MIDI Remote Script novation/launchkey_elements.py (used by Launchkey_Mini_MK3; decompiled, non-official)
sources.note: drum pads notes 36–51 on channel 10 (DRUM_CHANNEL = 9); in DAW mode the pots are CC 21–28 on channel 16

sources.title: DrivenByMoss LaunchkeyPadGrid.java, Launchkey Mini MK3 (Bitwig; non-official)
sources.note: Drum layout on the 2 × 8 pads, channel 10: bottom row 36 37 38 39 44 45 46 47, top row 40 41 42 43 48 49 50 51; Windows ports "Launchkey Mini MK3" and "MIDIIN2 (Launchkey Mini MK3)"

sources.title: giezu/LaunchkeyMiniMK3 — reverse-engineered MIDI implementation (non-official)
sources.note: Drum-mode pads send notes on channel 10; keys, custom-mode knobs and pads, pitch bend and modulation arrive on "Launchkey Mini MK3 MIDI 1", DAW traffic on "MIDI 2" (Linux names)

sources.title: Spectrasonics — Setting up the Launchkey Mini mk3 (non-official)
sources.note: relies on the factory Custom pot mode: knobs 1–8 = CC 21–28 (hold Shift, press the Custom pad on the top row)

notes: Standalone, MIDI port: pads in Drum mode (hold Shift, press the 2nd top-row pad), knobs in Custom pot mode (hold Shift, press the top-right pad). Novation publishes no programmer's reference for the Mini, so: the pad notes and channel 10 are confirmed by Ableton's and DrivenByMoss's scripts (the 2 × 8 arrangement by DrivenByMoss); the knob CCs 21–28 come from Spectrasonics only and their channel is assumed — knobs, the Mod strip and the key range are marked unverified (學習 rebinds them). Session mode and the Device/Volume/Pan/Sends pot modes need a DAW and talk on the DAW port, not modelled. Shift, Transpose, Octave, >, Stop·Solo·Mute, Arp, Fixed Chord, Play and Record send nothing on the MIDI port in standalone use. No LED feedback.

controls.label: Mod
controls.note: Novation only calls it the Modulation strip; CC 1 is the MIDI modulation controller but no Novation document prints the number. 學習 rebinds it.
Factory Custom pot mode sends CC 21–28 (Spectrasonics); its MIDI channel is not documented — channel 1 assumed. Select Custom: hold Shift, press the top-right pad.

controls.label: Keys
controls.note: Lowest key at octave 0 is not printed in the docs; C2 = 48 (Novation names middle C C3) is assumed. Keys follow any note on channel 1, so octave shifts just scroll.
